items.title: Albert Warner Interview, 1959-01-08
items.q: I went playing along with them, so I went with Chris Kelly and different fellas, you know, I would go around playing with.

ctx.x: I went playing along with them, so I went with Chris Kelly and different fellas, you know, I would go around playing with. Okay, that's good. So the next band I got with was Kid Rene. Well, I stayed with Kid Rene a good while. And I was-
